judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a classic rubber ducky shape with a distinct body and head, colored bright yellow.
The duck must have an orange beak and a simple black dot for an eye.
Draw a white, claw-foot bathtub shape, showing the inside view with a visible rim.
Fill the lower portion of the bathtub with light blue water.
requirements.note: The tub interior is solid white foam edge to edge; the only light blue water visible is an 8-pixel sliver at the right rim (1.2% of the interior area). No blue water fills the lower portion of the tub in the render.

requirements.text: Ensure the water line is clearly visible across the duck's body, showing the lower third of the duck submerged.
requirements.note: No water line is drawn anywhere across the duck - its yellow body simply ends where the white foam begins, so nothing shows a lower third submerged.

requirements.text: Position the duck so it is floating on the water's surface, creating small, concentric circular ripples in the water around its base.
requirements.note: No water surface is visible in the tub, and there are no ripple lines of any kind around the duck's base.

requirements.text: Depict soap bubbles as clusters of overlapping circles with a slight iridescence, using semi-transparent white, light pink, and light blue fills.
requirements.note: The foam bubbles are white only. The pink on the airborne bubbles is a hairline iridescent crescent of 4-21 pixels, invisible at render scale, so there is no light pink fill.

requirements.text: Place a small cluster of bubbles on top of the duck's head.
Place a large pile of bubbles against one side of the tub and a few floating on the water's surface around the duck.
